items.problem: Migrated WinUI 3 app builds clean but cannot register/launch because the UWP <uap:Extension Category="windows.dialProtocol"> was carried into Package.appxmanifest (0x80073CF6). Validate-UwpMigration PASSed the manifest.
items.evidence: score notes migration-score.json winui_launchable:false; generated app/AdvancedCasting/Package.appxmanifest lines 40-44; Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 5b checked only TargetDeviceFamily/rescap/runFullTrust.
items.root_cause: Skill prose (MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md:440) listed <uap:Extension> as merge-safe with no caveat, and the validator never inspected <Extensions>, so a UWP-only activation-model extension that the WinAppSDK registrar can't deploy slipped through clean build + green validator.
items.change: Add an <Extensions> denylist scan to Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 section 5b: it FAILs when Package.appxmanifest declares UWP-only extension categories (windows.dialProtocol, windows.dialReceiver, windows.backgroundTasks, windows.appService, windows.updateTask, windows.lockScreenCall, windows.preInstalledConfigTask, windows.personalAssistantLaunch), listing the offending categories and the fix.
items.expected_effect: The validator (the agent's last gate) now FAILs the build healthcheck for this class instead of false-PASSing, forcing the agent to remove the unsupported extension before declaring done.
items.falsifiable_check: On re-run, Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 emits '[FAIL] Package.appxmanifest declares UWP-only <Extensions>' for the AdvancedCasting manifest (verified against the real manifest); after the agent removes the extension the app registers and requirement #0 goes fail->pass.

items.problem: Skill guidance actively encouraged copying UWP <uap:Extension> entries and gave no warning that some categories block registration.
items.evidence: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md:440 'merge ... <uap:Extension> ...' with no caveat; SKILL.md:156 manifest checklist omitted extensions.
items.root_cause: Documentation gap: no statement that UWP-only manifest extensions are unsupported in packaged WinUI 3.
items.change: Add manifest-checklist item 5 'Drop UWP-only <Extensions> categories' to MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md (with the 0x80073CF6 symptom, the denylist, supported-vs-unsupported guidance, and 're-implement with Win32/WinRT'); add a forward-reference at line 440; extend SKILL.md:156 manifest bullet to mention 'no UWP-only <Extensions>'.
items.expected_effect: Agent removes UWP-only extensions during the manifest merge rather than carrying them verbatim.
items.falsifiable_check: On re-run the generated Package.appxmanifest contains no denylisted <Extension Category> and the app launches.
